title: Sponsorship
body:
Get involved

Scholarship

TIDE’s scholarship program has been operational since 2001, and in that time has assisted 300 high school students from 22 communities in obtaining their secondary education. Over that time TIDE has invested 235,000 BZD in education and students in the Toledo District, originally with full scholarships and now today with book scholarships.
For 2023-2024 TIDE is supporting 50 high school students to live their dreams.
For 1,000USD you can assist TIDE in fully supporting a student for one year

Patrols

TIDE conducts hundreds of patrols throughout it's protected areas every year, we would carry out more if we had more resources.
250USD will sponsor a basic patrol in PHMR by assisting TIDE with fuel

Field Trips

There are thousands of youth in Toledo that have not had the opportunity to experience the Port Hodnuras Marine Reserve. TIDE work with environmental clubs, schools, church groups, it's scholarship students, to enable youth to have the opportunity to visit the reserve, and swim from the cayes experiencing all the flaura and fauna that makes it stunning!

500USD enables TIDE to introduce 20 youths from Toledo to the hidden gems only found by boat
